Vehicle access to West MacDonnell National Park from [[Alice Springs]] is via Larapinta Drive and Namatjira Drive. From the direction of Uluru - Kata Tjuta National Park, the unsealed Red Centre Way (4WD recommended) connects Watarrka National Park (Kings Canyon) with West MacDonnell National Park. Simpsons Gap is also accessible via a 17-km sealed bicycle track beginning opposite Flynn's Grave, 7 km from [[Alice Springs]] along Larapinta Drive.
